name: NGGB
recent: Nextgreen Global Berhad 近期出现董事与大股东在公开市场及闭门期内的持股变动，同时因 ESOS 行使而分批发股上市。公司公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度业绩，营收与净利均环比增长。
notable: 董事 Dato' Lim Thiam Huat、Dr Lim Kah Yen 与 Miss Lim Kah Yee 在 2026 年 8 月 26 日及 9 月 1 日于公开市场及闭门期内增持公司股份。
公司因 ESOS 行使分别于 2026 年 10 月 16 日及 11 月 10 日上市共 90,000 股新股。
公司公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度业绩，净利 1,049.5 万令吉。
risks: 董事在闭门期内表明交易意向，并在闭门期内进行股份交易。
ESOS 行使持续小幅稀释现有股东持股。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度营收 2,677.4 万令吉，环比增长 50.5%，同比增长 29.1%；净利 1,049.5 万令吉，环比增长 31.9%，同比增长 3.8%；净利率 39.2%，低于上一季度的 44.7%。

recent_en: Nextgreen Global Berhad recently saw changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests through open market and closed period dealings, alongside tranches of new shares listed from ESOS exercises. The company reported quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026, with both revenue and net profit rising quarter-on-quarter.
notable_en: Directors Dato' Lim Thiam Huat, Dr Lim Kah Yen and Miss Lim Kah Yee acquired shares on the open market and during the closed period on 26 August and 1 September 2026.
The company listed a total of 90,000 new shares from ESOS exercises on 16 October and 10 November 2026.
The company announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026, with net profit of RM10.495 million.
risks_en: Directors indicated intention to deal during the closed period and conducted share dealings within the closed period.
Continued ESOS exercises modestly dilute existing shareholders' holdings.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM26.774 million, up 50.5% qoq and 29.1% yoy; net profit was RM10.495 million, up 31.9% qoq and 3.8% yoy; net margin was 39.2%, lower than 44.7% in the previous quarter.
